audience_text:
One row is: one inpatient census event for a patient at a specific point in time, representing where that patient was counted in the hospital census.

Who's in it: patients with a recorded patient ID who had a Census event during the chosen date range, in the chosen service area and location when running the report. Choosing All for service area includes every service area, and choosing All for location includes every location. The report leaves out events from these departments: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

Each row shows: the patient’s census placement, the clinical and operational categorization of the stay, the department and service area, room and bed details, and identifying information for the event and location records.

Time window: it includes census events with an effective time from the chosen start date through the chosen end date, including the whole end date. It shows the data as it stood at the end of the chosen as-of date: the event itself must have been entered by then, and a canceled event is still included if it was not deleted until after that date.

Excludes: records without a linked patient; canceled events that had already been deleted by the as-of date; and records from the excluded departments listed above.

This selection contains census ADT events for patients, one event at a time, during the chosen event date range, using an inclusive end date. It shows the event date and census day, patient, patient class, service, department, room, bed, service area, and the event record identifiers.

It reflects the data as it stood at the chosen as-of date: events are included only if they had been created by then, and canceled events are still included if they were not deleted until after that date. It excludes records without a patient, records that do not match the two other required linked selections, and events in these departments: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

This selection keeps departments that are in a service area chosen when running the report. If the choice is All, it includes departments from every service area; otherwise it includes only departments whose service area matches one of the chosen values.

It uses hospital location setup and ADT event history, along with the department’s service area, room and bed context, patient class, and patient service details where available.

It carries a constant flag of 1 for each included department-service area match.

This selection represents the location choices made when running the report, using the revenue location linked to each department. It includes either the specific revenue locations that were chosen, or all locations when the choice is All.

It draws those location options in the context of hospital ADT activity and related bed, room, department, service area, patient class, and patient service reference information. Each row also carries a constant flag of 1, likely just to mark that the location choice matched.

Shows the ADT event category for each census event included in the report, limited to events that occurred during the chosen date range, as the data stood on the As Of date, for patients with linked records in the other required report selections and with a recorded patient ID. Excludes events in these departments: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

Shows whether each census event was active or canceled for a patient bed placement event that was scheduled during the chosen date range, counting the end date in full, as the data stood on the As Of date; canceled events are still included if they were not deleted until after that As Of date. Excludes records without a patient, records not in the separately defined required patient selections, and events in these departments: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

The field is the date and time when the census event was scheduled to occur. It includes census events during the chosen date range, using an inclusive end date, as the data stood on the As Of date: events had to be created before the day after that date, canceled events are kept only if they were not deleted until on or after the day after that date, and it excludes records without a patient, records not in the required linked selections, and events in these units: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

The patient identifier for each census event that fell during the chosen date range, using the data as it existed on the As Of date. Excludes canceled events that were already canceled before that As Of date, events created after that date, records without a patient, records not in the two required linked selections, and events in these departments: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

Patient class as of the report snapshot for each census event during the chosen date range. The report uses the event only if it was created before the As Of date, keeps canceled events only when they were still present as of that date, limits results to events tied to a patient and to the separately defined required record sets, and excludes events in these departments: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

The patient location event’s unit name abbreviation, based on census ADT activity in the chosen date range; it reflects the record as it stood on the As Of date, includes canceled census events only if they were still not deleted by then, and excludes events for the listed procedural and emergency areas, records without a patient, and records that do not meet the linked selection checks.

This field is the department recorded for the patient at the event’s effective time.

The patient’s room from the census ADT event, based on where the patient was assigned at the event’s effective time.

Includes census events that happened during the chosen date range, using an inclusive end date, as the record stood on the As Of date; it keeps events that were active then, including canceled ones only if they were canceled after the As Of date, and excludes events not linked to a patient, events outside the separately defined patient selections, and events in these departments: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

The bed name for each census event, using the patient location event as it stood on the As Of date. Time window: includes events that were supposed to happen from the Start Date through the End Date, inclusive; keeps events created before the day after the As Of date, and if an event was later canceled, keeps it only when the cancellation happened on or after the day after the As Of date. Excludes: records without a patient, records not in the two required linked selections, and events in these departments: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

The patient service for each census event, using the patient’s service that was in effect on the event date and time.

Time window and excludes: includes census events that were supposed to happen during the chosen start through end dates, treating the end date as inclusive, and shows the data as it existed on the chosen As Of date. It excludes records without a patient, records not found in the required linked selections, and events in these units: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

Deletion timestamp for the census ADT event record. It comes from census events for patients in the chosen reporting period, using the data as it stood on the As Of date, and it excludes records not linked to a patient, records failing the separately defined patient and encounter selections, and events in these departments: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

When this report is run, this field shows when the census ADT event record was entered into the system, for events scheduled to occur during the chosen date range, using the data as it stood at the As Of date. It excludes records without a patient, records not found in the required linked selections, events from these units — CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR — and treats canceled events as included only if they were still not deleted before the As Of date.

The service area is the service area tied to the department on the census event, shown as the service area name.

Time window: this comes from census ADT events that were scheduled to happen during the chosen date range, including the full end date, and it reflects the data as it stood on the chosen As Of date, so events created after that point are not included and canceled events are kept only if they were still not deleted by then. Excludes: events without a patient, events not in the separate required patient selections, and events in these units: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

The field is the department’s unique ID for each qualifying census event. It includes events that were scheduled to happen during the chosen date range, using the report’s as-of date to reflect the record as it existed then, excludes events in the listed emergency, imaging, cath lab, operating room, psychiatry, and DSC OR departments, and also excludes records without a patient or without the required linked records.

The room record ID identifies the room tied to each included census bed event. It is taken for events that happened during the chosen date range, as the data stood on the As Of date, for linked patients only, and it excludes events in these units: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

Bed record ID for each census ADT event in the chosen date range, based on the event’s effective time. Time window and exclusions: it reflects the data as it stood at the chosen As Of date, includes events from the Start Date through the End Date inclusive, keeps canceled events only if they were still not deleted by that As Of date, requires a recorded patient and matching records in two separate required selections, and excludes events in these departments: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

The ADT event record unique is the unique identifier of each census ADT event that was included. It covers census events whose effective time falls during the chosen date range, using an inclusive end date, as they existed as of the chosen As Of date; it excludes records without a patient, records not in the separately defined required populations, canceled events that were already deleted before that As Of date, and events in these departments: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

The field shows the calendar day of each census ADT event, using the event’s effective date and time. It includes events during the chosen Start Date through End Date, treats the End Date as inclusive, reflects the data as it stood on the chosen As Of Date, and excludes canceled events removed before that As Of Date, records without a patient, records not linked through the required related selections, and events in these departments: CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.
